brand_identity.name: Upxero Ordering
brand_identity.market: Belgium & Netherlands (Horeca: restaurants, takeaways, snack bars)
brand_identity.tone_and_voice: Professional, calm, trustworthy, practical, ultra-fast, Dutch-first. Serious SaaS product, non-distracting, high utility.
brand_identity.core_value: 0% Commission, 100% Restaurant Ownership & Direct Customer Ordering
anti_patterns: No food marketplace aggregator look (e.g. UberEats / Thuisbezorgd generic yellow/orange marketing banners)
No fake charts or vanity analytics widgets in dashboard
No huge hero marketing banners inside the operational dashboard
No transparent dropdowns or unreadable text low-contrast elements
No universal transitions like transition: all

dashboard.audience: Restaurant owners and kitchen/front-of-house staff in Belgium/Netherlands
dashboard.aesthetic: Calm, dense, high-contrast operational tool. Crisp 1px slate borders, quick status toggles, zero clutter, immediate scanning.
dashboard.layout_mode: High Density Grid (Mode B). Left fixed sidebar navigation + top operational header + dense main workspace content.

ordering_page.audience: End customers ordering food on mobile phones or desktop
ordering_page.aesthetic: Mobile-first, friction-free, appetizing, ultra-responsive. Sticky category navigation, quick product customization modal, slide-over cart, instant pickup/delivery toggle.
ordering_page.layout_mode: Mobile-first single column with floating sticky bottom cart bar on mobile, 2-column wide layout on desktop (menu grid + sticky right order summary).

colors.archetype: ORGANIC & PERFORMANCE PRO HYBRID (Slate Navy + Emerald Trust + Warm Amber Accents)

grid_systems.dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

rules: Use explicit transition properties such as transition-colors duration-200 or transition-transform duration-150. NEVER use transition: all.
Hover effects on dashboard cards: subtle shadow boost (shadow-md) and 1px border shift to border-slate-300.
Order status update button click: micro feedback scaling (active:scale-95).
Cart drawer: slide-in from right/bottom with backdrop blur backdrop-blur-sm bg-slate-900/40.

cards.dashboard_stat: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-5 flex items-start justify-between
cards.order_card: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-4 hover:border-slate-300 transition-all space-y-3
cards.menu_item_card: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-4 flex justify-between gap-4 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow

buttons.primary: bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-sm active:scale-[0.98] transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-sm active:scale-[0.98] transition-all
buttons.outline: border border-slate-300 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-lg active:scale-[0.98] transition-colors

forms_and_inputs.input: w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3.5 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-emerald-600 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-600/20 transition-all
forms_and_inputs.switch: shadcn/ui switch component with emerald active track (bg-emerald-600)
forms_and_inputs.select: shadcn/ui custom select component with solid background (never transparent)

testing_attributes.mandatory_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all dashboard text is in clear, natural Dutch (Overzicht, Bestellingen, Menu, Categorieën, Instellingen, Bezorging, Openingstijden, Profiel).
Use react-icons or lucide-react for all interface icons. Do not use emoji characters for functional icons.
Ensure Shadcn components used (Dialog, Drawer, Select, Switch, Tabs, Table) are styled with Upxero brand palette (Emerald active state, Dark Slate headers).
Use sonner for instant toast notifications (e.g. 'Nieuwe bestelling ontvangen', 'Menu item opgeslagen').
Customer ordering flow (/order/:slug) must be 100% responsive and tested for phone viewports with sticky bottom cart drawer.
Ensure data-testid attributes are attached to all buttons, inputs, links, cards, and modal triggers as required.
